text:
tala: quick design follow-up from today's arch sync — proposing a 'predictive microvariant' fallback pattern. idea: instead of immediate rollback or broad thinning, create tiny convex-model variants (microvariants) that trade a few token-level features for memory/latency. controller predicts when to shift traffic to microvariants preemptively.

jeff: sketch out the decision surface? curious how predictive it avoids false positives and oscillation.

tala: decision surface = short-horizon forecast + confidence band. we ingest rolling metrics (p50/p95 latency, alloc GC pressure, kv eviction rate) and run a tiny predictor that outputs risk_score in [0,1]. policy maps risk_score -> microvariant level. only switch when predictor confidence > 0.8 and warm-start mirroring has validated outputs.

marta: what are microvariants concretely? model weight tweaks? quantization? or request-time transforms?

tala: primarily request-time transforms and tiny model config deltas. examples: (A) drop long-term retrieve results (very cheap), (B) reduce reranker beam from 8->4, (C) apply 4-bit per-channel quantization on ephemeral GPU-only variant. each microvariant has a precomputed equivalence bound from offline evals.

soph: nice taxonomy. ops cost seems bounded since microvariants are small and can be compiled into the same binary image with flags. still need warm caches. how do we warm them?

tala: mirror+replay. controller can mirror a small fraction and replay cached requests to microvariants to prepopulate KV and VV caches. warm window decays after X minutes. plan: mirror 1% for 10m, compute drift metric, then open a 0.1% traffic gate if drift < threshold.

jeff: drift metric definition? avoid sending any raw user text to telemetry.

tala: use synopsized equivalence tokens: for each sampled request compute hash(prefix_trunc) + model-topk-signature (top-3 token ids with logits delta). store only 8-byte prefix of SHA256, and aggregated delta counts. reservoir-sample at 0.02% to keep cardinality in check.

marta: fallback triggers? microvariant should be able to self-heal back to base variant. need hysteresis and circuit-breaker semantics.

tala: agree. propose multi-axis rule: if observed latency or error breach OR predictor risk_score > 0.9 -> escalate to next microvariant; but rollback occurs if 1) SLA breach sustained for 2m OR 2) sampled drift > threshold OR 3) operator abort. downward moves occur only after stable window (10m) with low risk and drift.

soph: how does session affinity work with microvariants? switching mid-session could confuse stateful flows.

tala: microvariants are session-aware: controller pins session_id -> base_variant for stateful modes. for stateless paths we allow microvariant routing. also maintain a lightweight per-session 'variant-lease' header so downstream can route consistently for TTL. header example: `X-Variant-Lease: base=abc;lease_until=1670000000`.

jeff: can you show router pseudocode and predictor contract?

tala: sure — pseudocode below:

```
# incoming request handling (router side)
meta = collect_metrics(request)
risk,conf = predictor.evaluate(meta, model_id, tenant_id)
if conf >= 0.8 and risk >= policy.threshold_for_scale_up:
  proposed = policy.select_microvariant(risk)
  if mirror_mode: mirror_to(proposed)
  elif approved_gate_for(proposed, tenant):
    route_to(proposed)
  else:
    route_to(base)
else:
  route_to(base)
```

```
# predictor contract (tiny HTTP rpc)
POST /predict
body: {metrics: [...], short_ts: 1670000, model: "m-xlarge"}
resp: {risk_score: 0.73, confidence: 0.82}
```

marta: rollout and operator checklist? need a simple recipe for Dedicated/Private customers.

tala: operator checklist in RFC: 1) enable predictor in read-only mode (no routing), 2) run mirror 0.5% to microvariants for 30m, 3) validate drift < 0.2% on sampled corpus, 4) enable autopilot but with conservative thresholds and a manual abort switch, 5) enable warm-replay for 5-10m before shift. for Private, predictor runs in-customer control plane; we ship a tiny predictor binary and compatibility shim.

jeff: instrumentation: emit variant-lease header and a brief trace tag `micro_variant:id` and `equiv_digest` for sampled requests. keep sampling low (0.02%).

sre-bot: scheduled job: predictor-canary/microvariant/mirror -> staging (job id: 889120).

soph: one more thought: have a synthetic canary corpus for each model created from recent production prompts (anonymized). use it to baseline microvariant equivalence nightly.

tala: yes — synthetic canary corpus + reservoir-sampled live checks gives two orthogonal signals. will add to RFC.

marta: sounds good. can you add a small YAML example for policy and thresholds?

tala: on it — minimal config:

```yaml
microvariant_policy:
  predictor_conf_threshold: 0.8
  risk_thresholds: [0.3, 0.6, 0.9]  # maps to microvariant tiers
  mirror_pct: 0.5
  warm_replay_minutes: 10
  sampling_pct: 0.02
  drift_threshold_pct: 0.2
  stabilize_minutes: 10
```

tala: i'll open the RFC follow-up and a tiny staging canary for mirror/replay. tagging @jeff @marta @soph for review. thumbs if you agree. :thumbsup:
